# Highland Yak Chew

> Highland Yak Chew is a UK brand selling natural, long-lasting dog chews and treats made from a centuries-old Himalayan recipe. Every chew is made from just three natural ingredients — yak milk, cow milk, and lime juice — with no grains, preservatives, or artificial additives.

## About

Highland Yak Chew sources yak milk directly from Himalayan farming cooperatives and turns it into hard cheese chews that are high in protein, low in fat, grain-free, and highly digestible. The chews are odourless, do not stain, and are designed to keep dogs occupied for days. When a chew gets too small to chew safely, microwaving the leftover piece puffs it into an edible crunchy treat, so there is no waste.

- Country served: United Kingdom (GB)
- Currency: GBP (£)
- Delivery: Standard UK shipping £1.99; free UK delivery on orders over £30; typical delivery 2–5 working days
- Returns: 14-day hassle-free returns
- Ingredients: Yak milk, cow milk, lime juice, pinch of salt — no grains, preservatives, or additives

## Products

- [Yak Milk Chews](https://highlanddogchew.co.uk/products/yak-chews): Hard, long-lasting natural cheese chews made from yak and cow milk. Available in multiple sizes for different dog breeds.
- [Puff Treats](https://highlanddogchew.co.uk/products/puff-treats): Light, airy, crunchy puffed yak milk treats — gentle on teeth and ideal for puppies, senior dogs, and quick training rewards.
- [Highland Mix](https://highlanddogchew.co.uk/products/highland-mix): A variety box combining yak milk chews and puff treats — ideal for multi-dog households or trying different textures.

## Common questions

- Are bones safe for dogs? Cooked bones are not safe — UK veterinary bodies including the PDSA and RSPCA advise against them, because cooking makes bone brittle so it splinters into sharp fragments. Raw bones are less brittle but still risk fractured teeth, salmonella and campylobacter contamination, constipation and intestinal blockage. A hard cheese chew such as a yak milk chew is a longer-lasting option without the splintering risk.
- How does a yak chew compare to rawhide? A yak chew contains one food — milk — while rawhide is a hide by-product often chemically treated during processing that can swell in the stomach if swallowed in large pieces. Yak chews are grain-free, low in fat and over 55% protein.
- Are yak chews safe for dogs? Yes — they are natural, highly digestible, low in fat and lactose, grain-free, and contain no artificial additives. Always supervise chewing and pick the correct size.
- Are they suitable for puppies? Suitable for puppies with adult teeth (roughly 4–6 months+) under supervision; soften the end in warm water for younger pups. Puff Treats are a gentler option for young puppies.
- How long does a chew last? Typically several days to a few weeks of regular chewing, depending on the dog's size and chewing strength.
